variance_rule: Cosine mean over all pairs/tokens. For diversity, average predicted/teacher fields over repeated horizons sharing (episode,anchor), compute population std across distinct anchors at each fixed camera/spatial/channel coordinate after sqrt(2048) scaling, then average relu(0.5*teacher_std-prediction_std). Teacher is detached. One anchor gives zero penalty and explicit support count. Entire logical batch required; no microbatch averaging. Diagnostic coefficients only; Step 4 freezes production coefficients and short-batch policy.
